question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"leading."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Leading"** means to be in front or to guide others. (सर्वोत्तम या सबसे महत्वपूर्ण) • **Example**: *The CEO was **leading**__ the company towards success.* • Grammatically, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage:** The automobile industry is one of the __**leading**__ industries at the global level. It plays a crucial role in the development of the global economy because of the high revenues and increased customer demands. The automobile industry helps to ______ (2) _______ economic development of the country; therefore, it is widely recognised as a major economic sector. The automobile industry consists of multiple companies ______ (3) _______ in car manufacturing, as well as the ones involved in marketing and distribution of automobile products, such as cars, buses, vans, trucks, motorcycles, mopeds and ______ (4) ________ bicycles. The global automobile industry incorporates several large car manufacturers' blocs that work ______ (5) ______ at the global level. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Jumping"** refers to leaping off the ground. (कूदना; छलाँग लगाना) • **"Shortening"** means to make something shorter. (छोटा हो जाना या कर देना) • **"Moving"** is a general term for changing position. स्‍थान बदलना या किसी वस्‍तु को अन्‍य स्‍थान पर ले जाना, हिलना या हिलाना; खिसकना या खिसकाना) 3e:Te32, The correct answer is** "foster."**
